name: C. Linus Cavendish
original_name: C・ライナス・ キャヴェンディッシュ
source:
Favorite Tea: Darjeeling 

The young head of the prestigious Cavendish family. Though he comes from an ancient lineage, he dislikes conservative thinking. With his outspoken personality and firm belief in meritocracy, he has many enemies among the aristocracy, who place class above all else. However, he is also well-liked because he takes good care of those he favors. When it comes to tea, he prefers it simple and served straight.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/tea/teaparty.htm]official website[/url]]
